name_zh: 尼泊尔·比伦德拉：国王屠杀与君主废除悲剧
name_en: Nepal Birendra: Royal Massacre & Monarchy Abolition Tragedy
description_zh: 比伦德拉 (1945-2001) 尼泊尔国王 (1972-2001)，2001年皇宫屠杀全家遇害，弟弟贾南德拉继位加速君主制合法性崩塌，2008年制宪会议废除君主制，悲剧重塑尼泊尔政治版图。
description_en: Birendra (1945-2001) Nepal King (1972-2001), 2001 royal palace massacre entire family killed, brother Gyanendra succession accelerated monarchy legitimacy collapse, 2008 Constituent Assembly abolished monarchy, tragedy reshaped Nepal political landscape.
reason_zh: 比伦德拉屠杀代表君主制神圣光环如何在瞬间崩塌，展示了皇室内部权力斗争如何成为制度变迁催化剂，其悲剧性结局直接推动了尼泊尔从印度教王国向世俗共和国转型。
reason_en: Birendra massacre represents how monarchy sacred aura collapses in instant, demonstrating how royal family internal power struggle becomes regime change catalyst, its tragic ending directly drove Nepal transition from Hindu kingdom to secular republic.
steps_zh: 研究比伦德拉早年哈佛教育与1972年继位
分析1990年人民运动恢复多党民主与国王妥协
探讨2001年皇宫屠杀迪彭德拉疯狂屠杀全家
评估贾南德拉继位专制倒行逆施加速共和
总结国王屠杀君主废除悲剧对尼泊尔世俗共和国的决定性推动
steps_en: Study Birendra early Harvard education and 1972 accession
Analyze 1990 Peoples Movement restored multi-party democracy and king compromise
Explore 2001 royal palace massacre Dipendra madness killing entire family
Evaluate Gyanendra succession authoritarian regression accelerating republic
Summarize royal massacre monarchy abolition tragedy decisive push for Nepal secular republic
expected_zh: 理解皇室悲剧如何成为制度变迁黑天鹅事件，掌握君主制合法性崩塌与共和制建立的因果链条，评估尼泊尔世俗化转型的独特历史路径。
expected_en: Understand how royal tragedy becomes regime change black swan event, grasp monarchy legitimacy collapse and republic establishment causal chain, evaluate Nepal secularization transition unique historical path.
case_zh: 1945 出生；1972 即位；2001 屠杀遇害；2008 君主废除。国王屠杀君主废除悲剧范式永存。
case_en: 1945 birth; 1972 accession; 2001 massacre death; 2008 monarchy abolished. Royal massacre monarchy abolition tragedy paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Royal massacre; monarchy abolition; secular republic; Hindu kingdom end
